items.title: What Does Costco Wholesale (COST) Nationwide Same Day Delivery Mean For Members?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) has rolled out nationwide same-day delivery across the U.S. through DoorDash for its members. The expanded arrangement now covers all U.S. Costco warehouses, giving shoppers access to thousands of items for rapid fulfillment. DoorDash will handle orders placed via its app and website. These orders are sourced from nearby Costco locations and sent to customers. The nationwide same-day delivery expansion with DoorDash is a key move that needs weighing against...
